description: One call: create a curated trip packing list and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links); default amazon.se. Without marketplace/country, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com. Preferred agent path: create a packing list and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, listUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

country.description: Optional ISO country code of the end user, e.g. US → amazon.com, SE → amazon.se. Used when marketplace is omitted.

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a packing item

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user: amazon.com (United States — English titles, USD prices, amazon.com /dp links) or amazon.se (Sweden, SEK). Also accepts ids like us / se. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for US users. If omitted: country is used, then the caller's Accept-Language (en-US → amazon.com), else amazon.se. Unknown values fall back to amazon.se (never an error).

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill packing list
